name: Nedap N.V.
summary: Nedap N.V., together with its subsidiaries, develops and manufactures electronic equipment and software in the Netherlands, Germany, rest of Europe, North America, and internationally. It offers software services, which support healthcare institutions in planning, registering, and administering care processes. Its healthcare software services include Nedap MediKIT, a cloud-based HIS designed to grow with general practitioners and their practices; Luna, an electronic day calendar that helps people with cognitive disabilities manage activities of daily life; and Nedap Ons, a comprehensive EHR solution that supports the full care process.
